findings.reason: a node implementing the sentence literally either calls the classifier on a liveness move (contradicting the sentence it was told to implement) or omits it and fails its own exited-worker measure, so the sentence has to admit a liveness move alongside an input move.
findings.text: "The full classifier runs only when inputs move" contradicts the two sentences before it and the section's own done-when: a worker exit moves no classification input (`recovery_memo._classification_inputs` is the pointer, manifest, stream, run-directory records, review-store candidates and tree head — recovery_memo.py:450–480), yet :181 requires that run to "read its new verdict on the next tick", and the cited exemplar settles it the other way — `recovery_watch._quiet_beat_snapshots` calls the full `_watch_snapshot` when the liveness triple moved (recovery_watch.py:2573–2580), while the only cheap re-derivation in the tree, `_stall_reading`, returns just `waiting` or `stalled` from `dispatched`/`working` (recovery_watch.py:698–707) and cannot produce an exit verdict
